description: Get one published episode by id: description, duration, listen_url, audio_url, show_url, chapters with links that start playback at each chapter, and optionally the speaker-labeled transcript. Use it after search_catalog or latest_episodes when someone wants to know what an episode covers, jump to a part, or quote it. An unknown or unpublished id returns a tool error.

episode_id.description: Episode id from search_catalog or latest_episodes.

include_transcript.description: Also return the transcript. Leave off unless you need to quote or summarize it.

max_transcript_chars.description: Cut the transcript at this many characters; transcript.truncated says whether it was cut.

name: get_episode

audio_url.description: Direct MP3 URL, for players or downloads.

chapters.description: Chapters in order; empty when the episode has none.

listen_url.description: Listen page that starts playback at this chapter.

start.description: Chapter start as m:ss or h:mm:ss.

episode_id.description: Pass to get_episode for chapters and transcript.

listen_url.description: Public web page that plays the episode in any browser. Give this to a person.

show_url.description: Public page for the episode's show.

transcript.description: Present only when include_transcript is true; null if the episode has no public transcript.

truncated.description: True when text was cut at max_transcript_chars.

title: Episode details
